Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer agent hallucinated a specific interpretation of the USGS data. While the USGS page correctly identifies Mount St. Helens as part of the Cascade Range formed by subduction (a convergent boundary), the agent incorrectly stated that the source "aligns best with D) rift zones among the provided options." This is a factual error; subduction zones are convergent boundaries (Option A), not rift zones (Option D). The agent confused the mention of "back-arc extension" (which can occur behind a subduction zone) with the primary formation process of the volcano itself, leading to a wrong conclusion that contradicted the overwhelming evidence of subduction presented in the same text.
